info.title: Top Ledger Wallet Intelligence Pay API
info.description: Pay-per-request Solana wallet intelligence APIs for portfolio analysis, token holdings, DeFi positions, rewards, and DEX PnL.

tags.name: Wallet Intelligence
tags.description: Paid Solana wallet portfolio and DeFi intelligence endpoints.

x402Payment.name: X-PAYMENT
x402Payment.description: Signed x402 or MPP payment proof generated by pay.sh.

get.description: Analyze a Solana wallet and return total net worth, token holdings, DeFi positions, protocol exposure, rewards, and DEX PnL in one response.

parameters.name: wallet
parameters.description: Solana wallet address in base58 format.

200.description: Wallet intelligence response after payment settlement.

total_net_worth_usd.description: holdings + lending net + perp collateral + staking + lp + yield + rewards + governance. Excludes DEX trading positions to avoid double-counting with on-chain holdings.

value_usd.description: USD value of native SOL plus Jupiter-verified SPL / Token-2022 holdings.

token_count.description: Number of distinct holdings after Jupiter verified-token filtering.

protocol.description: Protocol identifier. Stable string — safe to switch on programmatically.

deposit_value_usd.description: Total USD value supplied/deposited into this protocol by the wallet.

borrow_value_usd.description: Total USD value borrowed from this protocol by the wallet.

net_value_usd.description: deposit_value_usd − borrow_value_usd. Can be negative if borrows exceed collateral valuation.

positions.description: Number of open perpetual positions on this protocol.

size_usd.description: Total notional position size in USD. Null if unknown.

collateral_usd.description: Total USD value posted as collateral.

pnl_usd.description: Combined PnL (realized + unrealized for Jupiter; unrealized only for Flash). Null if unknown.

token_symbol.description: Symbol of the staked token (e.g. SOL, JUP).

token_mint.description: Mint address of the staked token. Null if not applicable.

price_usd.description: Current USD price per token. Null if unknown.

locked_amount_jup.description: Jupiter DAO only: JUP amount still locked in escrow.

locked_value_usd.description: Jupiter DAO only: USD value of JUP still locked in escrow.

unlocked_amount_jup.description: Jupiter DAO only: JUP amount in partial unstakings, including withdrawable amounts.

unlocked_value_usd.description: Jupiter DAO only: USD value of JUP in partial unstakings.

faf_price_usd.description: Flash only: current USD price for FAF token staking.

sflp_pool_prices_usd.description: Flash only: per-pool sFLP staking prices used in Flash staking valuation.

positions.description: Number of staking positions on this protocol (e.g. validator stakes, escrows).
Number of LP positions on this protocol. For Parcl, pending withdrawal settlement requests are included.

value_usd.description: Total USD value of LP positions. Null if unknown.
USD value of yield-bearing positions on this protocol.

deposited_value_usd.description: USD value of deposited governance tokens. Null when prices are unavailable.

deposits.description: Number of non-zero governance token deposits.

active_protocols.description: Deduplicated list of all protocol identifiers that contributed any position to this wallet across all categories.

schema.title: AnalyzeWalletResponse
schema.description: Master portfolio overview: total net worth + per-category breakdown across holdings, lending, perpetuals, staking, LP, yield, rewards, and governance deposits.

402.description: Payment Required. Retry with a signed x402 or MPP payment header.

WWW-Authenticate.description: Payment challenge understood by pay.sh clients.

get.description: List native SOL, SPL, and Token-2022 holdings for a Solana wallet with real-time USD pricing and optional minimum-value filtering.

parameters.name: wallet
parameters.description: Solana wallet address in base58 format.

parameters.name: min_value_usd
parameters.description: Minimum USD value per holding to include in the response. Defaults to 1.

200.description: Wallet intelligence response after payment settlement.

total_value_usd.description: Sum of value_usd across all holdings (excluding any unpriced tokens).

holdings_count.description: Number of holdings included in the response.

mint.description: Token mint (base58). For native SOL the canonical wrapped-SOL mint is used.

price_usd.description: USD price per token. Null if no price feed is available.

value_usd.description: balance × price_usd. Null if price is unknown.

holdings.description: Holdings sorted by value_usd descending. Includes native SOL and Jupiter-verified SPL / Token-2022 tokens only. NFTs (decimals=0, balance=1) and known fungible LP/share mints (Kamino Vaults, Raydium AMM/CPMM, Loopscale Vaults, Kamino Liquidity) are excluded.

schema.title: HoldingsResponse
schema.description: On-chain token holdings with USD pricing. Returns native SOL plus Jupiter-verified SPL / Token-2022 token balances only to reduce scam-token noise and price discrepancies. Filtered by `min_value_usd` query param (default 1).

402.description: Payment Required. Retry with a signed x402 or MPP payment header.

WWW-Authenticate.description: Payment challenge understood by pay.sh clients.

get.description: Return lending deposits, borrows, and net value for a Solana wallet across supported Solana lending protocols.

parameters.name: wallet
parameters.description: Solana wallet address in base58 format.

200.description: Wallet intelligence response after payment settlement.

total_deposit_value_usd.description: Sum of deposit_value_usd across all protocols.

total_borrow_value_usd.description: Sum of borrow_value_usd across all protocols.

net_value_usd.description: total_deposit_value_usd − total_borrow_value_usd. The wallet's net lending exposure.

protocol.description: Protocol identifier. Stable string — safe to switch on programmatically.

deposit_value_usd.description: Total USD value supplied/deposited into this protocol by the wallet.

borrow_value_usd.description: Total USD value borrowed from this protocol by the wallet.

net_value_usd.description: deposit_value_usd − borrow_value_usd. Can be negative if borrows exceed collateral valuation.

protocols.description: Only protocols with non-zero positions are included. Empty array if the wallet has no lending activity.

schema.title: AllLendingResponse
schema.description: Aggregated lending positions across all supported lending protocols (Kamino, Project Zero, Loopscale vaults/loans/direct strategies, Jupiter Lend, Carrot).

402.description: Payment Required. Retry with a signed x402 or MPP payment header.

WWW-Authenticate.description: Payment challenge understood by pay.sh clients.

get.description: Return DEX trading positions for a Solana wallet with FIFO cost basis, current value, realized and unrealized PnL, and seven-day trading performance.

parameters.name: wallet
parameters.description: Solana wallet address in base58 format.

200.description: Wallet intelligence response after payment settlement.

position_count.description: Number of currently held DEX-tracked positions.

total_cost_basis_usd.description: Sum of FIFO cost basis across all current positions.

total_current_value_usd.description: Sum of current_value_usd across all positions.

total_unrealized_pnl_usd.description: Sum of unrealized_pnl_usd across all positions.

total_unrealized_pnl_pct.description: Aggregate unrealized PnL as a percentage of total cost basis.

realized_pnl_usd.description: Total realized PnL over the last 7 days.

buy_volume_usd.description: Total USD value of buys over the last 7 days.

sell_volume_usd.description: Total USD value of sells over the last 7 days.

total_trades.description: Total number of buy + sell trades over 7 days.

realized_pnl_usd.description: Realized PnL in USD for that day (from FIFO matching).

daily_pnl.description: Day-by-day realized PnL for the last 7 days.

qty.description: Current token balance held by the wallet.

avg_cost_usd.description: FIFO average cost basis per token in USD.

cost_basis_usd.description: Total USD cost basis remaining for this position.

current_price_usd.description: Latest known USD price per token.

unrealized_pnl_pct.description: Unrealized PnL as a percentage of cost basis.

positions.description: Current DEX positions filtered to mints actually held on-chain. Sorted as returned by the position store; capped by the `limit` query param (default 50, max 100).

schema.title: AllDexResponse
schema.description: Wallet DEX trading positions with FIFO PnL tracking + 7-day performance summary. Only includes mints currently held on-chain (no phantom positions from transferred-out / burned tokens).

402.description: Payment Required. Retry with a signed x402 or MPP payment header.

WWW-Authenticate.description: Payment challenge understood by pay.sh clients.
